profile.name: Sarah Jenkins
profile.reason: She wants to feed her children healthier versions of their favorite crispy foods without spend hours cooking or cleaning up after traditional frying.

conversation.question: Do you have any suggestion for this product
conversation.answer: I'd love to see pre-programmed settings tailored specifically for popular kid meals like chicken tenders or veggie fries, plus a cheat sheet for quick weeknight prep. Also, making sure every removable part is 100% dishwasher-safe would save busy parents even more cleanup time!

conversation.question: what makes it less appealing than other products
conversation.answer: I honestly love it, but if I had to pick something, the capacity can be a little limiting when I'm trying to cook dinner for the whole family at once. Sometimes I have to cook in batches, which adds time back into my evening routine.

profile.name: Elena Rostova
profile.personality: Traditional, skeptical of modern gadgets, and frugal
profile.reason: She believes authentic flavor requires traditional oil-based cooking and feels the appliance would just take up limited counter space without delivering equal taste.

conversation.question: Do you have any suggestion for this product
conversation.answer: My main suggestion would be to significantly reduce its footprint on the countertop, or make it easy to store away. Unless an appliance can genuinely replicate the rich, authentic flavor of traditional stovetop cooking with oil, I can't justify letting it take up precious kitchen space.

conversation.question: what makes it less appealing than other products
conversation.answer: It's a bulky, expensive unit that simply cannot replicate authentic flavor. Real cooking with traditional methods produces far better taste, and I refuse to surrender my limited counter space to a single-use gadget that doesn't deliver equal results.

profile.name: Maya Patel
profile.reason: Living in a small apartment, she values quick single-portion meals that fit her fitness goals and minimize heat and mess compared to a standard oven.

conversation.question: Do you have any suggestion for this product
conversation.answer: It would be great to have optional divider inserts for the basket so I can cook a protein and a vegetable side simultaneously for quick single-portion meals. Also, offering sleeker, modern aesthetic options or a slightly narrower design for small apartment counters would be amazing!

conversation.question: what makes it less appealing than other products
conversation.answer: Compared to something like a versatile toaster oven, some of these models are quite bulky for a small apartment counter. Plus, if you want to cook a larger portion or meal-prep for the week, the basket size can feel a bit restrictive.

profile.name: Rachel Adams
profile.reason: While she respects the health benefits of using 90% less oil, her testing showed the texture didn't match genuine deep-frying, making the investment unappealing for her culinary tastes.

conversation.question: Do you have any suggestion for this product
conversation.answer: If you want to win over culinary purists, you need to refine the crisping technology. Maybe incorporate dual heating elements or precise humidity control so the exterior gets that truly shatter-crisp crunch of actual deep-frying without drying out the inside.

conversation.question: what makes it less appealing than other products
conversation.answer: From an analytical perspective, the trade-off isn't worth the cost. The food ends up drier rather than truly crispy, and it lacks the rich texture profile of genuine deep-frying. If a product compromises the primary culinary experience, it loses its appeal for me.
